channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Marcus Morris | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Marcus Morris from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Nick Nurse on former Sixer Marcus Morris, who signed with the Cavs for the rest of the season today:

“I miss him, I’ve always really liked him. He brings a level of toughness that I love. He’s a very capable player on both ends, with some size and a lot of physicality.”

Nick Nurse on Marcus Morris, Mar 29, 2024. Source: Twitter @LaurenMRosen.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Nicolas Batum, Marcus Morris, Robert Covington
item.description:
L Frank on Morris/Batum/Covington:

“There will be great competition. All three are really good players. All three bring different things.”

Lawrence Frank on Nicolas Batum, Marcus Morris, Robert Covington, Sep 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Al Horford on Marcus Morris, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Al Horford:

“It was Game 7, about four minutes to go in the fourth quarter. It was still a very close game and we're getting out of the timeout and I'm looking at Marcus Morris, I'm looking at Jayson Tatum, Jaylen, myself. We're gassed. It's Game 7, we're giving everything we have. I'm in great shape and I'm still like just very tired from the game... andI look at the other side and he's sitting kind of like in the scores table just leaning very casual. He's played the whole every single minute up to that point and he looked unfazed, he looked unbothered and and to me that was disturbing the fitness level the conditioning that he's in.”

Al Horford on Marcus Morris, Jayson Tatum, Mar 30, 2023. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Andrew Greif:Ty Lue:

“It was nothing Marcus did wrong, just trying something different. And when you’re not playing well you want to try something different and a Marcus was all for it. We have to sacrifice if we want to win at a high level.”

Tyronn Lue on Marcus Morris, Mar 28, 2023. Source: Twitter @AndrewGreif.

item.title: Eric Gordon on Paul George, Russell Westbrook, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris
item.description:
Law Murray:Eric Gordon on Clippers closing lineup that included him, Kawhi Leonard, Paul George, Russell Westbrook, Marcus Morris Sr. Sunday night vs Grizzlies:

“I just think we were a little desperate,you know. We had the right mindset and attitude.”

Eric Gordon on Paul George, Russell Westbrook, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Mar 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @LawMurrayTheNU.

item.title: Markieff Morris on Marcus Morris, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Markieff Morris on past issues between Luka Doncic and twin brother Marcus:

“There’s no personal beef, no vendetta. That’s just how we play sometimes. We might foul the shit out of you. It just is what it is. ... Some people might call it dirty. I just call it playing tough.”

Markieff Morris on Marcus Morris, Luka Doncic, Feb 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @CallieCaplan.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Ty Lue on his personnel plans for tomorrow's preseason opener vs. Denver:

“I'm not gonna play PG or Nico tomorrow, and Marcus won't play either. But everybody else (who's healthy) will be available.”

Tyronn Lue on Marcus Morris, Oct 3, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Terance Mann on Rajon Rondo, Patrick Beverley, Marcus Morris
item.description:
Terance Mann says hello -- and goodbye for 2020-21:

“Everybody had a hand in my development this season, from top to bottom fro Pat Beverley to Rondo to PG to Kawhi to Serge ... Marcus Morris was a big help.”

Terance Mann on Rajon Rondo, Patrick Beverley, Marcus Morris, Jul 1, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Luke Kennard on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Luke Kennard on Marcus' role defensively:

“He's a physical defender, and that's what we need, especially this late in the playoffs. Hopefully he's good to goand we'll see what he can do. But we definitely need him out there.”

Luke Kennard on Marcus Morris, Jun 21, 2021. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann
item.description:
Eric Walden:Quin Snyder, on the Clippers:

“Because [Leonard and George are] such great players, there’s some tendency not to talk about other guys on their team— guys like Mann coming in, what Morris did today, Kennard, the defense that Batum played.”

Quin Snyder on Paul George, Nicolas Batum, Kawhi Leonard, Marcus Morris, Luke Kennard, Terance Mann, Jun 6, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Tyronn Lue on Marcus Morris
item.description:
“The crazy part about it is that Marcus came to me and said, ‘Listen, T-Lue, me coming off the bench is gonna be great,’”

Tyronn Lue on Marcus Morris, Jan 9, 2021. Source: Orange County Register.

item.title: Lawrence Frank on Marcus Morris
item.description:
“We are delighted that Marcus has chosen to continue his career with the Clippers,”

Lawrence Frank on Marcus Morris, Nov 25, 2020. Source: NBA.com.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Mirjam Swanson:Doc Rivers defends his guy on ESPN's in-game interview:

“He got ejected because he's Marcus to be honest. He made a play on the ball and his hand followed through. But we can't worry about that, we have to play better.”

Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @MirjamSwanson.

item.title: Luka Doncic on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Luka on Morris play:

“I didn’t want to think (Game 5 play) was on purpose, but after today’s play . . . I don’t want to deal with players like that.”

Luka Doncic on Marcus Morris, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Brad Townsend:Carlisle on Morris play:

“I knew he was getting ejected. I knew it was a flagrant-2. It was a very unnecessary play.”

Rick Carlisle on Marcus Morris, Aug 30, 2020. Source: Twitter @townbrad.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris, Luka Doncic
item.description:
Jovan Buha:Doc Rivers on the Marcus Morris-Luka Doncic interaction from Game 5:

“The Marcus thing is absurd. I don’t know why we’re even talking about it. ... It’s absolutely absurd.”

Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris, Luka Doncic, Aug 26, 2020. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris, Luka Doncic
item.description:
“That wasn't enough for anyone else to get involved. There was nothing there. Marcus and Doncic really were having a conversation. For him to come into that, to me it had to be something else earlier, that him and Marcus got into. There was not enough for him to run in and be the peacemaker. There was no war going on.”

Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris, Luka Doncic, Aug 18, 2020. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Kawhi Leonard on Marcus Morris, Landry Shamet
item.description:
Kawhi Leonard on Marcus Morris & Landry Shamet adjusting to a fully healthy team:

“I think they're doing good. They just didn't knock down shots today. It's just one of those days. They had good looks, just didn't knock them down.”

Kawhi Leonard on Marcus Morris, Landry Shamet, Mar 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @Farbod_E.

item.title: Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Doc on the intel the Clippers received on Marcus Morris:

“A lot of research goes into when you make a trade, especially with this team and where we're trying to go. You can't take any chances. You have to make sure guys are a good fit. ... All the intel we had was very positive.”

Doc Rivers on Marcus Morris, Feb 8, 2020. Source: Twitter @jovanbuha.

item.title: Scott Perry on Marcus Morris, Reggie Bullock
item.description:
Knicks GM Scott Perry on the signings of Marcus Morris & Reggie Bullock:

“With Reggie & Marcus we are adding two more versatile, hard-nosed & accomplished players to an already improved roster. We value both players' perimeter shooting & their strong presence”

Scott Perry on Marcus Morris, Reggie Bullock, Jul 16, 2019. Source: Twitter @IanBegley.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Nicola Yang:Brad Stevens:

“I really hope Marcus [Smart] finally gets recognized as an All-Defensive Team member. We've thought ever since he got here that he's one of the best defenders in the league.”

Brad Stevens on Marcus Morris, Mar 4, 2019. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Terry Rozier on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Terry Rozier on Mook:

“Marcus Morris is simply a gamer. You can put it any way you want it. He’s a gamer, he gets the job done. He’s came in with the same attitude every day and he’s a professional. So I’m never worried about what he’s going to do. He’s a gamer, he gets it done.”

Terry Rozier on Marcus Morris, Oct 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Chris Forsberg:Marcus Smart on Marcus Morris’ BWA (Bench With Attitude) nickname:

“We have the toughest team, the toughest bench, the toughest coach. I definitely have a lot of attitude,I know Morris has some attitude, I know other guys have some attitude. I'm rocking with the name.”

Marcus Smart on Marcus Morris, Sep 26, 2018. Source: Twitter @ChrisForsberg_.

item.title: Marcus Smart on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Marcus Smart on Marcus Morris’s fight:

“I'll take that any day, him giving it everything that he has, leaving it all out on the court, than somebody who's out there trying to be pretty boy or Cinderella … I want somebody who's going to go to war for me.”

Marcus Smart on Marcus Morris, May 17, 2018. Source: Twitter @ESPNForsberg.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Stevens on Morris:

“He provides some defensive versatility for us that's really important against guys like Giannis and Parker.”

Brad Stevens on Marcus Morris, Apr 16, 2018. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
Danny Ainge:

“I’m excited about the playoffs. I really am. Like, Terry Rozier and Shane Larkin, this is their opportunity. And Jaylen [Brown] and Jayson [Tatum] and Marcus Morris and [Al] Horford and [Aron] Baynes and Greg Monroe, I mean, the whole group. These guys are looking forward to playing in the playoffs. And we have the luxury to give them a little bit of rest without taking them completely out of rhythm in these last four games, which is very rare to be able to do heading into the playoffs.”

Danny Ainge on Greg Monroe, Al Horford, Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Shane Larkin, Terry Rozier, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Apr 5, 2018. Source: Boston Herald.

item.title: Stan Van Gundy on Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes
item.description:
Jay King:Stan Van Gundy on Aron Baynes and Marcus Morris:

“I've coached in this league a fairly long time now and those are two of my favorite guys. I mean, tough, team-oriented guys who will try to do whatever it takes to win.”

Stan Van Gundy on Marcus Morris, Aron Baynes, Nov 27, 2017. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Danny Ainge on Gordon Hayward, Marcus Morris
item.description:
“It’s next man up, opportunities for the guys that [were not] going to get these opportunities all of a sudden play with no Marcus Morris and no Gordon Hayward. That’s 65 minutes a game right there. Until we find a deal that we like, we’ll do all we can to be patient.”

Danny Ainge on Gordon Hayward, Marcus Morris, Oct 22, 2017. Source: Boston Globe.

item.title: Stanley Johnson on Marcus Morris
item.description:
#PistonsStanley Johnson on Marcus Morris:

“Marcus was helpful to me in my 2 years here. He's a great player and an even better teammate.”

Stanley Johnson on Marcus Morris, Jul 7, 2017. Source: Twitter @detnewsRodBeard.

item.title: Markieff Morris on Marcus Morris
item.description:
Candace Buckner:Markieff Morris on his brother Marcus:

“He's going to be here every game-- I wouldn't say in my jersey... I don't have enough jerseys.”

Markieff Morris on Marcus Morris, Apr 16, 2017. Source: Twitter @CandaceDBuckner.
